# Information Security Policy

## Passwords

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Passwords are changed only when there is a sign of compromise, not on a fixed schedule.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, the ERP system and the VPN.

## Laptops

All company laptops use full disk encryption. A lost or stolen laptop must be reported to the IT security team within 2 hours.
Personal USB storage drives are blocked on company laptops.

## Data Classification

Data is classified as Public, Internal, Confidential or Restricted. Customer payment data and employee Aadhaar numbers are Restricted.
Restricted data may not be sent over email or stored on personal devices.

## Incident Reporting

Report suspected phishing emails using the Report Phish button. Security incidents are tracked by the IT security team, who must acknowledge a report within 30 minutes during business hours.
